findings.passage: Second, it requires an acceptable form of ID to be submitted with the application. If the applicant does not have an acceptable ID, they may use last four digits of SSN along with the signature of a witness.
findings.note: His written testimony to a Senate committee on Senate Bill 582 (indefinitely confined voters). Describes the bill's ID requirement for the application and its fallback for people with no acceptable ID.
subjects: what happens to a voter with no ID

findings.passage: In 2020, the county clerk in Dane County urged voters to claim indefinite confinement in order to bypass our voter ID law and begin receiving absentee ballots automatically in each election.
findings.note: Same testimony on Senate Bill 582. He says the indefinitely confined status was used to get around the voter ID law.

findings.passage: I believe that this bill will strike a balance between protecting the integrity of our elections and ensuring that those who are truly indefinitely confined have access to absentee ballots.
findings.note: Closing of the same testimony.
